claim.claim-text: 1. A method of producing a refined fermented beverage, comprising the steps of:

2. The method according to Claim 1, wherein the step of removing at least a portion of the neutralized acidic congener comprises, and preferably consists of, filtering the neutralized acidic congener from the treated fermented beverage.
3. The method according to either Claim 1 or Claim 2, wherein the addition of the alkaline treating agent raises the pH of the fermented beverage solution to at least 5.5, and up to 8.5.

4. The method according to any of Claims 1-3, wherein the alkaline treating agent either comprises an alkali metal hydroxide or alkaline earth metal hydroxide, preferably sodium hydroxide, or the alkaline treating agent comprises a weak base, preferably sodium acetate.
5. The method according to any of Claims 1 to 4, wherein the step of treating the fermented beverage solution comprises the steps of:
6. The method according to any of Claims 1 to 5, wherein the acidic congener within fermented beverage solution comprises more than one acid, preferably more than one organic acid, and:

(i) the step of treating the fermented beverage solution with the alkaline treating agent neutralizes at least a portion of the acids, or all, of the acids, within the fermented beverage solution; and (ii) the step of removing the neutralized acidic congener removes at least a portion of the neutralized acids, or all, of the neutralized acids, from the treated fermented beverage solution.

7. The method according to any of Claims 1 to 6, wherein at least 50 percent, and up to at least 99.9 percent, of the acidic congener, preferably comprising acetic acid, is neutralized upon the addition of the alkaline treating agent to the fermented beverage solution.
8. The method according to any of Claims 1 to 7, wherein the refined fermented beverage comprises the following properties:

9. A refined fermented beverage, produced by the method according to any of Claims 1 to 8, the refined fermented beverage having a reduced or negligible concentration of an acidic congener, preferably acetic acid, relative to the fermented beverage solution.
10. The refined fermented beverage according to Claim 9, wherein substantially all, preferably all, of the organic acidic congeners in the fermented beverage were neutralized.
11. The refined fermented beverage according to Claim 10, wherein substantially all, preferably all, of the organic acidic congeners were separated from the fermented beverage.

12. The refined fermented beverage according to any of Claims 9 to 11, wherein the fermented beverage has a pH value in the range of 5.0 to 8.7, preferably 5.5 to 8.5, in particular 5.5 to 6.7; and/or wherein the fermented beverage has an alcohol content of at least 0.05 and up to 65 % by volume; and/or wherein the fermented beverage comprises at least 10 and up to 20 %, by volume, ethyl alcohol; and/or wherein the fermented beverage is colorless; and/or wherein the fermented beverage comprises no vinegar-like flavor notes and/or odors; and/or wherein a combined concentration of acetic acid and acetate within the fermented beverage is less than 400 ppm; and/or wherein a concentration of acetic acid within the fermented beverage is 10 to 100 ppm, preferably 25 to 75 ppm.

13. A refined fermented beverage, the refined fermented beverage being a fermented beverage in which a portion or all of one or more acidic congeners have been neutralized by an alkaline treating agent to form a salt.

14. The refined fermented beverage according to Claim 13, in which a portion or all of the salt was subsequently removed from the neutralized fermented beverage to produce the refined fermented beverage.

15. A refined fermented beverage, preferably produced by the method according to any of Claims 1 to 8, the refined fermented beverage having reduced or negligible levels of organic acidic congeners, preferably acetic acid, relative to an untreated fermented beverage, the refined fermented beverage having the following properties:

16. A use of the refined fermented beverage according to any of Claims 9 to 15 and/or of a refined fermented beverage produced by the method according to any of Claims 1 to 8 to produce a flavored malt beverage.
17. A flavored malt beverage, produced by use of the refined fermented beverage according to any of Claims 9 to 15 or containing the same.
18. The flavored malt beverage according to Claim 17, including one or more flavoring and/or stability agents.
